correctness.rationale: The graph construction gives 20 vertices and 30 edges in each case. Simultaneous index shift by five is free; reduction of indices modulo five maps each vertex's three neighbors bijectively to those in G(5,2) (inner steps ±3 reduce to ∓2), so it is a two-sheeted covering, not just an orbit quotient. A triple lies on a geodesic exactly when its largest distance is the sum of the other two: concatenation of the two subpaths then realizes the endpoint distance. Consequently all 1,140 triples can be tested by exact distances, and larger faces are precisely the subsets containing no forbidden triple. Increasing-order enumeration prunes only nonfaces and includes every face exactly once by heredity, with no cutoff in the exact reconstruction. We independently reconstructed the two graphs by their rim, spoke and step edges, found all distances by BFS, enumerated the permitted subsets, constructed mod-two incidence columns by deleting one vertex, and reduced with exact XOR pivots; boundary compositions were checked to vanish. For k=2 and k=3 respectively, the forbidden counts are 540 and 720; face vectors are (20,190,600,550,60) and (20,190,420,370,60), with no higher nonzero entries; boundary ranks in degrees 1–4 are (19,161,379,60) and (19,131,289,60). The full one-skeleton ensures reduced H0=0 (also 20−19−1=0). Rank-nullity yields reduced Betti vectors (0,10,60,111,0) and (0,40,0,21,0); both alternating face sums equal −60. The unequal groups rule out homotopy equivalence without yielding integral homology or specifying either homotopy type. RESULT.md lines 25–70, VERIFICATION.md and verify_gp_covers.py were inspected; the frozen verifier was not executed. The independent reconstruction is replayable via python3 independent_gp_check.py, with its two-line exact result in independent_gp_check.out, retained separately in the private audit workspace.

value.rationale: These are two canonical cubic double covers of the same Petersen graph, not arbitrary unrelated examples. Their geodesic complexes match on Euler characteristic and number of top-dimensional simplices, yet exact mod-two ranks locate the topological distinction, including the presence versus absence of degree-two homology. This is a useful finite reference comparison of a natural invariant, apparently not determined by a known table or implication. The conclusion is explicitly about this pair, not a general statement about lifts or integral torsion.
